castleProgression.checks: No unexpected death; ordered maps; positions and FNV-1a framebuffer hashes at 20 checkpoints; three removed chain tiles; bridge tile changing from 0 to 4; movement/jumps and changing video on every gameplay map (the vertical drop map has no movement/jump requirement).
